data.title: Calculating the Area of Circles
data.description: Practice applying the formula A = πr² to determine the area of various circles given their radii or diameters, utilizing 3.14 for pi.

challenges.narration: A circular flower bed is shaped like this circle.
challenges.instruction: Find the area — the amount of space inside the circle.
challenges.hint: Area = π × r². Square the radius first, then multiply by π ≈ 3.14. Area is in square units.
